# `NET_FIGMA_TOKEN_EXPIRING`

| | |
|---|---|
| Severity | warning |
| Area | [Network (`NET_`)](README.md#domain-net) |
| Reported by | `cli` |

## What happened

The stored token expires within 14 days (personal access tokens last at most 90 days).

## What to do

Create a new token, or use a plan access token in CI.
